weather_line: Clearing by mid-morning · puddles under review · ducks at rest

stories.headline: Mrs. Holt Arrives at the Burrow End of Diagon Alley with Two Ducks and a Casserole; Ellie Greets Her as a Long-Lost Relative; Nobody Corrects Her
stories.byline: By our Familiars and Society correspondent
body: Elspeth Holt, 81, of the eastern ridge, made her first in-person visit to the household on Friday morning, arriving on foot with a wicker basket containing two additional enchanted ducks (one in a beret, one in what she described as 'a sensible cloche'), a covered dish of lamb and root vegetable casserole, and a tin of biscuits she did not mention and has not explained.

Ellie, who was stationed at the front window in her customary capacity as the household's least-reliable early warning system, greeted Mrs. Holt with a full-body wag, two circuits of the garden path, and an expression of profound recognition suggesting she believed she had known her personally for several years. Mrs. Holt accepted all of this without comment and gave Ellie a piece of biscuit from the unexplained tin. The two are now understood to be on excellent terms.

Lucy observed the entire arrival from the kitchen windowsill, confirmed the new ducks in under ten seconds, and has returned to her normal posture of total innocence. Jersey has claimed the warm spot nearest the casserole. The Jeep, reached for comment via Steve, is said to have taken the news of two more ducks 'in stride.'

stories.headline: Working Group Notes Reference 'Vault-Adjacent Drainage'; Christine Has Read the Notes; the Notes Have Been Read
body: The Standing Consultative Committee on Broadly Geographic and Adjacent Matters convened its third session Friday morning, during which the Subgroup on Standing Water and Comparable Phenomena tabled a preliminary working paper on the forty-year puddle at the eastern end of Diagon Alley. Page four, paragraph two, footnote six contains the phrase 'vault-adjacent drainage channels (see Annex C, pending).'

Annex C has not been written. It is, however, listed in the table of contents. Christine has read the working paper in full, has noted the footnote, has noted the non-existent Annex C, and has placed a single sheet of Gringotts-headed notepaper on her desk. The notepaper is blank. This is, by all accounts, the most alarming thing the Committee has done so far.

Prentice-Hoole, asked whether the Committee intends to formally approach Gringotts on the matter of vault-adjacent drainage, said the Committee 'explores all avenues adjacent to its remit.' Asked to define 'adjacent,' he said the working group would address it in Annex D. Annex D is also not yet written. Tibbs, reached through a mutual contact, has still not replied to his non-voting invitation but was seen to read the working paper and set it down with the careful motion of a man choosing not to have an opinion.

stories.headline: Steve Submits the Spur's Full Map to the Household Record; the Jeep Is Cited as a Contributing Surveyor; Jeep Accepts the Credit Quietly
body: Following Friday's walk with Mrs. Holt, Steve has completed and submitted the formal trail record for the eastern spur — eleven hand-drawn pages, including two elevation sketches, a note on the root structure at the third switchback, and a starred annotation reading 'good rock' at the ridgeline. The Jeep is listed in the acknowledgements section as 'indispensable at the trailhead and at all times.'

Mrs. Holt contributed a single correction: a shortcut behind the old pine stand that does not appear on any existing map and that Steve estimates saves fourteen minutes on the descent. She drew it from memory, in pen, without pausing. The map has been filed. The Jeep has been told. The trail is considered fully known.

stories.headline: Friday's Close Completed Twenty Minutes Early; Surplus Time Directed Toward the Blank Notepaper; the Blank Notepaper Remains Exactly as Useful as Before
body: Christine cleared Friday's full ledger by half past three — four standard vault consultations, one renegotiated access schedule, and one account-holder who arrived with a handwritten list of grievances and departed, forty minutes later, having crossed all of them out personally. The remaining twenty minutes were applied to the blank sheet of Gringotts-headed notepaper on her desk.

The notepaper remains blank. Sources close to the notepaper confirm that this is intentional, and that it is considerably more effective blank than anything the Committee has managed to write. Griphook the Younger, passing the office at four o'clock, observed the blank page, asked no questions, and continued walking at a slightly faster pace than usual.

familiars_corner: Lucy: acknowledged the two new ducks within ten seconds of Mrs. Holt's arrival, catalogued the berets by charm-work era, and has been in the kitchen ever since — positioned, by pure coincidence, directly below the unexplained biscuit tin.

Ellie: has decided that Mrs. Holt is her grandmother, her best friend, and possibly the same person as the nice woman from last Tuesday, though she cannot confirm this as they are in her view the same general category of wonderful. She has brought Mrs. Holt a sock as a gift. Mrs. Holt has kept it.

Jersey: has assessed the casserole dish by proximity and warmth, determined it to be the superior heat source in the house, and installed himself beside it with the composed authority of a gentleman who has simply found his correct chair.
founding_editor_note: That casserole dish wants a trivet — you'll mark the table otherwise, and I built that table level in 1987 and I'd like it to stay that way. The ducks I have no notes on. — D.

in_brief.sport: Friday Strongwoman Standings: Christine's vault-adjacent notepaper reported to be carrying more weight than the entirety of Annex C.
in_brief.forecast: Fair through the weekend; the puddle persists; two new ducks settling in; casserole expected to last until Sunday if Jersey exercises restraint, which he will not.

storyline_updates.title: The Standing Consultative Committee on Broadly Geographic and Adjacent Matters
storyline_updates.summary: Day 3: The working group's preliminary notes on the Diagon Alley puddle contain a footnote referencing 'vault-adjacent drainage channels (see Annex C, pending).' Annex C does not exist. Christine has read the full paper, noted the footnote, and placed a blank sheet of Gringotts-headed notepaper on her desk. Prentice-Hoole has confirmed nothing and promised Annex D, which also does not exist. Tibbs has read the paper and chosen not to have an opinion. Day 4 (resolution): the Committee should formally and somewhat obliviously approach Gringotts on the drainage question; Christine should resolve the matter in a single meeting, possibly before Prentice-Hoole finishes his opening remarks; the blank notepaper should play a role; the Committee should be left technically intact but effectively redirected. Warm, swift, and final.
